escenas.voz: Right now, you're spinning at over 1,000 miles per hour… and you can't feel it.
At the equator, about 1,040 miles per hour. In Buenos Aires, about 850. Faster than an airliner.
So why aren't we flung off? Because you don't feel speed, you feel changes in speed. On a plane, you can sip water just fine.
Everything spins with you: the ground, your house, even the air. That's why there's no headwind.
The effect is real but tiny: about 300 times weaker than gravity. You weigh slightly less at the equator than at the poles.
And Earth also circles the Sun at about 66,000 miles per hour, while the solar system moves through the galaxy even faster.
All of that, right now. Did you know this? Follow for the universe in one minute.
